text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — billing metering: emitter pipeline lag (token counts delayed) and a surge of overage flags. Investigating now.
jamie.m: ack. I’m oncall — pulling dashboards.
sasha: :eyes: seeing emitter consumer lag on kafka-consumer-emit-01, lag ~120k msgs. Retention looks healthy, but consumer offsets stalled.
jamie.m: copying runbook section 'metering.consumer-lag' and checking consumer logs. Running `kc-consumer-info` now.
jamie.m: log snippet:
```
[2024-04-12T14:02:11Z] consumer-group emit-consumers partition 12 offset 1203412 -> 1203412 (no progress)
[2024-04-12T14:03:02Z] Unexpected EOF while reading batch
```

ops_lead: can we restart the consumer safely? Any risk of double-counting?

sasha: restart is safest short-term, but we need to pause notification pipeline before replay/backfill to avoid churned overage emails.

jamie.m: executing restart on kafka-consumer-emit-01 (graceful). Command:
```
sudo -u redwood /usr/local/bin/emit-consumer restart --group emit-consumers --grace 60
```

billing-team: we already have ~200 overage flags correlated to the lag window. Can we gate flags while we backfill?

nina: yes — toggling flagging switch in billing-filters: `flags.pause=true` for the emitter path. Will hold for up to 2h.

mathias: note for postmortem — this is the same partitioning skew that we saw in Q1. Recommend adding a consumer liveness probe and clearer offset alerting.

jamie.m: consumer came back up and started catching up. Lag down to 9k, making steady progress.

sasha: great. starting a controlled backfill job to emit the missing tokens to the billing pipeline. Will write idempotent markers to avoid duplicates.

billing-team: thanks — once backfill done we should run a reconcile job and then unpause flags. Also prepare short customer comms if any accounts are likely affected.

ops_lead: action list:
- jamie.m: monitor catch-up, confirm zero duplicate emits
- sasha: run backfill with idempotency markers
- billing-team: hold flags, prepare reconciliation
- nina: draft comms with estimated impacted window

jamie.m: will update every 15m or on status change. Current status: consumer healthy, backfill queued. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=P2, impact=billing visibility (delayed counts, temporary overage flags suppressed). Links: https://console.redwood/investigations/1745009999
